class.name: TAA
class.brief_description: Temporal Anti-Aliasing with per-pixel OpenGL 4.3 velocity vectors, Catmull-Rom history resampling, YCoCg variance clipping, and RCAS sharpening.
class.description: Applies sub-pixel camera jitter (Halton or R2) to the active 3D camera, rasterizes per-pixel rigid, [MultiMeshInstance], and skinned [Skeleton] motion vectors in OpenGL 4.3, and resolves temporal history using 5-tap Catmull-Rom filtering, 3x3 closest-depth velocity dilation, Karis luma weighting, YCoCg variance clipping, and contrast-adaptive sharpening.

method.name: get_history_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F previous-frame resolved history [Texture].

method.name: get_velocity_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F per-pixel velocity [Texture] (RG = UV velocity, B = linear view-space depth, A = speed in pixels).

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Clears stored previous-frame history and motion transforms. Call after camera cuts or teleports to avoid 1-frame ghosting.

members.member: Respects [SpatialMaterial] alpha-scissor cutouts in the velocity/depth pass.
Uses 5-tap Catmull-Rom bicubic resampling when reading history to prevent static image blurring.
Visual layer mask controlling which meshes are included in the velocity pass.
Visualizes velocity, jitter offset, or variance-clip rejection for debugging.
Enables real-time TAA inside the 3D editor viewport.
Master toggle for camera jitter, velocity generation, and temporal anti-aliasing.
Base blend weight toward accumulated temporal history on stationary surfaces.
Sub-pixel sampling sequence used to jitter the camera projection.
Reduces history weight on fast-moving pixels to minimize trailing and ghosting.
Clips reprojected history to the 3x3 YCoCg neighborhood variance box instead of min/max bounds.
Standard-deviation multiplier for YCoCg variance clipping. Lower values reject ghosting more aggressively; higher values increase temporal stability.
